scope: Add an explicit, profile/request-scoped cancellation action for bounded structured AI evaluation; keep the request active until any in-flight bounded provider call ends and discard the interrupted batch without persisting partial evaluation history.

acceptance.profile_and_request_scoped_cancel: PASS - a synthetic evaluation can be canceled only through its active profile and request ID; unknown profile/request returns cancelled=false, duplicate active request ID returns HTTP 409, and a completed request can no longer be canceled.
acceptance.bounded_provider_completion: PASS - cancel acknowledgement is returned while the second synthetic provider call remains in flight; the evaluation request finishes only after that call is released.
acceptance.partial_batch_history: PASS - first synthetic candidate completes, second remains in flight during cancellation, and no evaluation history is persisted for either profile after cancellation.
acceptance.connected_browser_flow: PASS - Chromium user flow starts evaluation, selects Cancel AI evaluation, sees pending acknowledgement, waits for bounded provider completion, sees canceled/discarded state, reloads, and confirms empty evaluation history.
acceptance.provider_inference: NOT_RUN - synthetic router only; no real local or paid provider inference was invoked.

limitations: Issue #5 / MJ-REQ-004 remains OPEN/PARTIAL; this slice covers structured AI evaluation cancellation only and does not complete operation timeout, captured-output, retry, or error-classification requirements across all operation categories.
